SELECT POPUP_SN, POPUP_NM, POPUP_CN, POPUP_PSTN_X, POPUP_PSTN_Y, POPUP_WDTH, POPUP_HGHT, PSTG_BGNG_YMD, PSTG_END_YMD, USE_YN, ATCH_FILE_MNG_NO, POPUP_URL_ADDR, LNKG_SE_CD, RGTR, REG_DT, MDTR, MDFCN_DT, DELTR, DEL_DT FROM POPUP_MST WHERE POPUP_SN = #{popupSn} AND DEL_DT IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO POPUP_MST ( POPUP_NM, POPUP_CN, POPUP_PSTN_X, POPUP_PSTN_Y, POPUP_WDTH, POPUP_HGHT, PSTG_BGNG_YMD, PSTG_END_YMD, USE_YN, ATCH_FILE_MNG_NO, POPUP_URL_ADDR, LNKG_SE_CD, RGTR, REG_DT ) VALUES ( #{popupNm}, #{popupCn}, #{popupPstnX}, #{popupPstnY}, #{popupWdth}, #{popupHght}, #{pstgBgngYmd}, #{pstgEndYmd}, #{useYn}, COALESCE(#{atchFileMngNo}, ''), #{popupUrlAddr}, #{lnkgSeCd}, #{rgtr}, NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE POPUP_MST SET POPUP_NM = #{popupNm}, POPUP_CN = #{popupCn}, POPUP_PSTN_X = #{popupPstnX}, POPUP_PSTN_Y = #{popupPstnY}, POPUP_WDTH = #{popupWdth}, POPUP_HGHT = #{popupHght}, PSTG_BGNG_YMD = #{pstgBgngYmd}, PSTG_END_YMD = #{pstgEndYmd}, USE_YN = #{useYn}, ATCH_FILE_MNG_NO = COALESCE(#{atchFileMngNo}, ''), POPUP_URL_ADDR = #{popupUrlAddr}, LNKG_SE_CD = #{lnkgSeCd}, MDTR = #{mdtr}, MDFCN_DT = NOW() WHERE POPUP_SN = #{popupSn} AND DEL_DT IS NULL
